# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# liquid-dsp (vendored subset) - static library for the TETRA demodulator.
#
# The upstream CMakeLists.txt is designed for a standalone build (examples,
# autotests, benchmarks, sandbox).  This wrapper only builds the library
# itself, using the same (upstream) source file lists, so that it can be
# embedded through add_subdirectory() from an Android NDK or host build.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(liquid C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

if(NOT LIQUID_SRCDIR)
    set(LIQUID_SRCDIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src")
endif()

# liquid.config.h is included by liquid.internal.h / libliquid.c and holds
# compile-time metadata.  Upstream generates it from cmake/liquid.config.h.in;
# we generate a minimal equivalent.
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/liquid.config.h"
"// generated by tetra-android/liquid_android.cmake
#ifndef __CONFIG_H__
#define __CONFIG_H__
#define PROJECT_COPYRIGHT   \"Joseph D. Gaeddert\"
#define PROJECT_LICENSE     \"MIT\"
#define PROJECT_AUTHOR      \"Joseph D. Gaeddert\"
#define PROJECT_HOMEPAGE    \"https://liquidsdr.org\"
#define PROJECT_DESCRIPTION \"Software-defined radio digital signal processing library\"
#define BUILD_GITHASH       \"null\"
#define BUILD_DATETIME      \"null\"
#define BUILD_HOSTNAME      \"null\"
#define BUILD_OS            \"null\"
#define BUILD_ARCH          \"null\"
#define BUILD_TOOLCHAIN     \"null\"
#define BUILD_TYPE          \"Release\"
#define BUILD_ENV           \"cmake\"
#define TARGET_OS           \"${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME}\"
#define TARGET_ARCH         \"${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}\"
#define LOGGING_ENABLED     1
#define LOGGING_LEVEL       3
#define COLOR_ENABLED       0
#define BUILD_ALTIVEC       0
#define BUILD_NEON          0
#define BUILD_MMX           0
#define BUILD_SSE           0
#define BUILD_SSE2          0
#define BUILD_SSE3          0
#define BUILD_SSSE3         0
#define BUILD_SSE41         0
#define BUILD_SSE42         0
#define BUILD_AVX           0
#define BUILD_FMA3          0
#define BUILD_AVX2          0
#define BUILD_AVX512        0
#define BUILD_AMX           0
#define BUILD_AMX101        0
#define BUILD_AMX102        0
#endif
")

file(GLOB LIQUID_SRCS
    ${LIQUID_SRCDIR}/*/src/*.c)

# The *.proto.c files are templates that are #included by other translation
# units and must not be compiled on their own.
list(FILTER LIQUID_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "\\.proto\\.c$")

# Architecture-specific SIMD variants (av/avx/avx2/avx512f/sse/neon) and the
# POSIX-only timer helper are not needed for the portable TETRA build.
list(FILTER LIQUID_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "\\.(av|avx|avx2|avx512f|sse|sse2|sse3|ssse3|sse41|sse42|neon)\\.c$")
list(FILTER LIQUID_SRCS EXCLUDE REGEX "timer\\.c$")

add_library(liquid STATIC ${LIQUID_SRCS} ${LIQUID_SRCDIR}/libliquid.c)
target_include_directories(liquid PUBLIC
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}"
    "${LIQUID_SRCDIR}")
target_include_directories(liquid PRIVATE "${LIQUID_SRCDIR}")

# TETRA only needs a small part of liquid; keep the build fast and portable.
target_compile_options(liquid PRIVATE -O3 -w)
if(NOT ANDROID AND NOT MSVC)
    target_link_libraries(liquid PUBLIC m)
endif()
